label: pjm 107 gas daily
definition: PJM 107 (leg A) — KEEPER (owner-adopted 2026-07-14, supersedes 2026-07-13-pjm-105-symmetric-net). Recipe: the pjm-105 symmetric-net keeper recipe (pjm-98 keeper recipe + net DA-virtual depth [symmetric form] + CT fast-start startup amortization on CAMPD-measured run horizons + the measured LONG_RUN top-of-curve floor) with EXACTLY ONE override: gas_daily_shape False->True — the measured Henry Hub daily within-month shape injected onto the gas price series, mean-preserving per month (the F923 plant-month re-carry keeps the daily swing on every overwritten gas plant-month). Solved on the G-A1-fixed gas_daily_shape_factors: the calendar-day factors are renormalized to mean exactly 1.0, so the monthly delivered mean is preserved to <$0.001/MMBtu (the pre-fix np.interp builder overshot by +$0.10/MMBtu in Jan-2024). Zero fitted scalars in the delta (rules 1/13/20/21: ex-ante measured daily HH prints, frozen against residuals; forecast-native). WHY KEEPER: holds every gated criterion pjm-105 held — C1 16/16 PASS (free-class 12/12), C2, C3a (2025 DA-diagnostic -11.4%→-10.0%, toward zero; 2023 held), C3b, C4, C5a, C7, C8 all PASS. Determination NOT-YET, on C3c alone: 2025 model DA-tail 6h vs actual 51h (>$200, 0.12×) — REDUCED from pjm-105's 17h, because the corrected mean-preserving daily gas concentrates winter cost onto the real cold-snap days and removes the flat-monthly baseline's over-pricing of ordinary January days, exposing that pjm-105's wider tail was substantially a flat-monthly-gas artifact. C3c is thereby confirmed a reserve opportunity-cost / LP-vs-MIP representation boundary, not an energy-stack input gap — no offer/gas lever reaches the actual 51h and none is tuned to the residual (rules 1/11/13). Keeper on structural fidelity (measured daily gas beats the flat-monthly estimate), not on lowest tail error. Zero-forcing ablation twin registered alongside (rule 20/D-3). docs/calibration-log.md 2026-07-14 PJM-107/108/109 entry; docs/DIAGNOSIS-pjm-dof-scarcity-tail-2026-07.md §B.4.
